claims.label: Host Says Military-Contracted Plane Dipped Low Over Provo Airport at 9:16 a.m.
claims.claim: The host says FlightRadar data shows a military-contracted plane from Biggs Army Airfield dipped to approximately 300 feet above the Provo Airport runway at 9:16 a.m. Utah time on September 10, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain raw FlightRadar/ADS-B Exchange records for the plane's full track; cross-reference with FAA Biggs Army Airfield outbound logs for 9/10/2025.

claims.label: Host Says Second Low Dip Came Approximately 26 Minutes After the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says the same military-contracted plane from Biggs Army Airfield dipped again to approximately 300 feet over the Provo Airport runway approximately 26 minutes after Charlie Kirk was shot, during its return leg to El Paso.
claims.investigative_direction: Corroborate the timing of the second dip against the publicly established time of the shooting and FAA flight records.

claims.label: Host Says N888KG Departed Provo at 1:20 p.m. on 9/10
claims.claim: The host says plane N888KG, which she describes as the Baugh-Maxfield plane, departed Provo Airport at 1:20 p.m. Mountain time on September 10, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check against FAA departure logs and Provo Airport (PVU) records.

claims.label: Maxfield statement on crew, passengers, and route
claims.claim: Derek Maxfield publicly stated that the N888KG plane departed Provo on 9/10 at 1:20 p.m. Mountain time with two pilots and no passengers, flew to Page, Arizona (PGA), where Derek Maxfield plus seven additional passengers boarded for the return trip to Provo.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify pilot identities and PGA passenger manifest through FAA and PGA airport records; obtain airport surveillance footage of boarding.

claims.label: Maxfield statement on FAA radar termination
claims.claim: Derek Maxfield publicly stated that radar services with Denver FAA Center and N888KG were terminated in mutual agreement approximately 10 miles from PGA, consistent with standard practice at non-towered airports.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the FAA termination claim against Denver Center controller logs and FAA standard operating procedures for non-towered airports.

claims.label: Host Says Egyptian Air Force Plane SU-BTT Arrived at Provo September 4 and Departed September 10
claims.claim: The host says FlightRadar data shows Egyptian Air Force plane SU-BTT arrived at Provo Airport on September 4, 2025 and departed Provo on September 10, 2025 at 7:14 a.m. local time, with an interim layover at Wilmington, Delaware before continuing to Cairo.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via raw FlightRadar history and ADS-B Exchange; cross-check Wilmington, Delaware airport logs; verify with Egyptian military public affairs and U.S. State Department foreign military landing notifications.

claims.label: Host Says SU-BTT's Three-Year Routing Pattern Runs Through Paris to Air Force Base Cities
claims.claim: The host says the FlightRadar three-year history for SU-BTT shows the aircraft routinely flies through Paris, and that she noticed the trend that it always flies to an Air Force base.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile full U.S. landing history; cross-reference landing locations with known U.S. Air Force installations.

claims.label: Email tipster claim: SU-BTT carried subcontractors dropped in Provo
claims.claim: The host says, citing an unnamed email tipster, that she can report as a fact that the SU-BTT flight carried Egyptian military subcontractors who were dropped off in Provo, Utah and did not make it back to Cairo when the plane departed.
claims.investigative_direction: Independently verify through State Department foreign military landing records, hotel logs in Utah County 9/4–9/10, and Egyptian Air Force roster cross-checks.

claims.label: Email tipster claim: discreet top-secret mission in Provo
claims.claim: The same unnamed email tipster claims the Egyptian military personnel were in Provo on a top-secret, discreet mission, and that the tipster was "scared for their life" in providing this information.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify independently; cross-reference with any joint U.S.–Egypt military exercise notifications or State Department disclosures.

claims.label: Daily Mail headline on Kash Patel shutting down foreign intelligence probe
claims.claim: The Daily Mail published a headline stating "Kash Patel shuts down Charlie Kirk foreign intelligence probe in an explosive feud with Trump's counter terror chief."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying Daily Mail article; identify what specific probe was referenced; request FBI/Patel on-record response.

claims.label: Josh Hammer op-ed "neutralize" language
claims.claim: Per the Daily Mail op-ed by Josh Hammer that the host reads, Hammer called Tucker's hosting of Nick Fuentes a "war on MAGA and the modern American right," and stated that "unless the fox is neutralized, the victim could be the entire extant GOP coalition itself."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full op-ed in original Daily Mail publication; document the "neutralize" framing in context.

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original X post URL; preserve deletion history and engagement metrics.

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full unedited Piers Morgan interview; verify clip is unedited.

But he has become the leading tip of the spear of what can only be described as a cancerous force running to engulf the entire American right."
